headline: Google releases new Gemini models, while the US threatens sanctions against Chinese AI models over IP theft, and Anthropic settles a $1.5B copyright lawsuit
tldr: Today's AI news is dominated by Google's release of new Gemini models, the US threatening sanctions against Chinese AI models, and Anthropic's $1.5B copyright settlement. Additionally, OpenAI launches a new program for small businesses, and NVIDIA announces new AI infrastructure developments. The AI landscape continues to evolve rapidly, with significant advancements in model development, industry partnerships, and regulatory actions.

new_models.title: Google releases three new Gemini models — but no 3.5 Pro
new_models.summary: Google released Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite, and Flash Cyber, but the continued absence of Gemini 3.5 Pro raises fresh questions about its AI strategy.
